ipa.financial_contracts.bond.Definition

API endpoint for Financial Contract analytics, that returns calculations relevant to each contract type.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.bond.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    *,
    instrument_code: str | None = None,
    instrument_tag: str | None = None,
    end_date: OptDateTime = None,
    direction: Direction | str = None,
    interest_type: InterestType | str = None,
    notional_ccy: str | None = None,
    notional_amount: float | None = None,
    fixed_rate_percent: float | None = None,
    spread_bp: float | None = None,
    interest_payment_frequency: Frequency | str = None,
    interest_calculation_method: DayCountBasis | str = None,
    accrued_calculation_method: DayCountBasis | str = None,
    payment_business_day_convention: BusinessDayConvention | str = None,
    payment_roll_convention: DateRollingConvention | str = None,
    index_reset_frequency: Frequency | str = None,
    index_fixing_lag: int | None = None,
    first_regular_payment_date: OptDateTime = None,
    last_regular_payment_date: OptDateTime = None,
    amortization_schedule: AmortizationItem | None = None,
    payment_business_days: str | None = None,
    adjust_interest_to_payment_date: AdjustInterestToPaymentDate | str = None,
    index_compounding_method: IndexCompoundingMethod | str = None,
    interest_payment_delay: int | None = None,
    stub_rule: StubRule | str = None,
    issue_date: OptDateTime = None,
    index_average_method: IndexAverageMethod | str = None,
    first_accrual_date: OptDateTime = None,
    floor_strike_percent: float | None = None,
    index_fixing_ric: str | None = None,
    is_perpetual: bool | None = None,
    template: str | None = None,
    fields: OptStrStrs = None,
    pricing_parameters: PricingParameters | None = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
    index_observation_method: IndexObservationMethod | str = None,
    fixed_rate_percent_schedule: dict | None = None,
    instrument_type: str = 'Bond',
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
instrument_code str | None No None Code to define the bond instrument.
instrument_tag str | None No None User defined string to identify the instrument. It can be used to link output results to the instrument definition. Only alphabetic, numeric and '- _.#=@' characters are supported.
end_date OptDateTime No None Maturity date of the bond to override. Mandatory if instrument code has not been defined and is_perpetual flag has been set to false. In case an instrument code has been defined, value comes from bond reference data.
direction Direction | str No None The direction of the leg. Optional for a single leg instrument (like a bond), in that case default value is Received. It is mandatory for a multi-instrument leg instrument (like Swap or CDS leg).
interest_type InterestType | str No None A flag that indicates whether the leg is fixed or float.
notional_ccy str | None No None The ISO code of the notional currency. Mandatory if instrument code or instrument style has not been defined. In case an instrument code/style has been defined, value may comes from the reference data.
notional_amount float | None No None The notional amount of the leg at the period start date. By default 1,000,000 is used.
fixed_rate_percent float | None No None The fixed coupon rate in percentage. It is mandatory in case of a single leg instrument. Otherwise, in case of multi leg instrument, it can be computed as the Par rate.
spread_bp float | None No None The spread in basis point that is added to the floating rate index index value. By default 0 is used.
interest_payment_frequency Frequency | str No None The frequency of the interest payments. Optional if an instrument code/style have been defined : in that case, value comes from reference data. Otherwise, it is mandatory.
interest_calculation_method DayCountBasis | str No None The Day Count Basis method used to calculate the coupon interest payments.
accrued_calculation_method DayCountBasis | str No None The Day Count Basis method used to calculate the accrued interest payments. By default, the same value than interest_calculation_method is used.
payment_business_day_convention BusinessDayConvention | str No None The method to adjust dates to a working day. In case an instrument code/style has been defined, value comes from bond reference data. Otherwise 'ModifiedFollowing' is used.
payment_roll_convention DateRollingConvention | str No None Method to adjust payment dates when they fall at the end of the month (28th of February, 30th, 31st). In case an instrument code has been defined, value comes from bond reference data. Otherwise, 'SameDay' is used.
index_reset_frequency Frequency | str No None The reset frequency in case the leg Type is Float. By default, the IndexTenor is used.
index_fixing_lag int | None No None Defines the number of working days between the fixing date and the start of the coupon period ('InAdvance') or the end of the coupon period ('InArrears'). By default 0 is used.
first_regular_payment_date OptDateTime No None The first regular coupon payment date for leg with an odd first coupon.
last_regular_payment_date OptDateTime No None The last regular coupon payment date for leg with an odd last coupon.
amortization_schedule AmortizationItem | None No None Definition of amortizations.
payment_business_days str | None No None A list of coma-separated calendar codes to adjust dates (e.g. 'EMU' or 'USA'). By default the calendar associated to notional_ccy is used.
adjust_interest_to_payment_date AdjustInterestToPaymentDate | str No None A flag that indicates if the coupon dates are adjusted to the payment dates. By default, 'false' is used.
index_compounding_method IndexCompoundingMethod | str No None A flag that defines how the coupon rate is calculated from the reset floating rates when the reset frequency is higher than the interest payment frequency (e.g. daily index reset with quarterly interest payment). By default 'Constant' is used.
interest_payment_delay int | None No None The number of working days between the end of coupon period and the actual interest payment date. By default, no delay (0) is applied.
stub_rule StubRule | str No None The rule that defines whether coupon roll dates are aligned on the maturity or the issue date. By default, 'Maturity' is used.
issue_date OptDateTime No None Date of issuance of the bond to override. Mandatory if instrument code has not been defined. In case an instrument code has been defined, value comes from bond reference data.
index_average_method IndexAverageMethod | str No None The value of the average index calculation method. The possible values are: ArithmeticAverage, CompoundedActual, CompoundedAverageRate, DailyCompoundedAverage
first_accrual_date OptDateTime No None Date at which bond starts accruing. In case an instrument code has been defined, value comes from bond reference data. Otherwise, default value is the issue date of the bond.
floor_strike_percent float | None No None The contractual strike rate of the floor. The value is expressed in percentages. If this parameter is set, the floor will apply to the leg with the same parameters set in the swapLegDefinition (e.g.maturity, frequency, index, discounting rule). No default value applies.
index_fixing_ric str | None No None The RIC that carries the fixing value. This value overrides the RIC associated by default with the IndexName and IndexTenor.
is_perpetual bool | None No None Flag the defines wether the bond is perpetual or not in case of user defined bond. In case an instrument code has been defined, value comes from bond reference data. In case of user defined bond, default value is 'false'.
template str | None No None A reference to a Adfin instrument contract or the Adfin detailed contract. Either instrument_code, template, or full definition must be provided.
fields OptStrStrs No None Contains the list of Analytics that the quantitative analytic service will compute.
pricing_parameters PricingParameters | None No None The pricing parameters to apply to this instrument. If pricing parameters are not provided at this level parameters defined globally at the request level are used. If no pricing parameters are provided globally default values apply.
extended_params ExtendedParams No None If necessary other parameters.
index_observation_method IndexObservationMethod | str No None (RFR) Method for determining the accrual observation period.
fixed_rate_percent_schedule dict | None No None The step structure: a list of pre-determined future coupon rates indexed by their dates. Either fixedRatePercent or fixedRatePercentSchedule is used. No default value applies.
instrument_type str No 'Bond' Instrument type definition for bond. Optional. Definition can be provided. Otherwise, default value is "Bond".

Example

import lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts as ldf
definition = ldf.bond.Definition(
   issue_date = "2002-02-28",
   end_date = "2032-02-28",
   notional_ccy = "USD",
   interest_payment_frequency = "Annual",
   fixed_rate_percent = 7,
   interest_calculation_method = ldf.bond.DayCountBasis.DCB_ACTUAL_ACTUAL
)
response = definition.get_data()

import lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts as ldf
definition = ldf.bond.Definition(
   fields = ["YieldPercent", "Duration", "RedemptionDateType", "RedemptionDate"],
   instrument_type = "Bond",
   instrument_code="250847EF3=TWBL",
   pricing_parameters=PricingParameters(
       redemption_date_type="RedemptionAtCallDate",
       price = 100,
       trade_date = "2020-05-01"
   )
)
response = definition.get_data()

# Using get_data_async
import asyncio
task = definition.get_data_async()
response = asyncio.run(task)

# Using get_stream
stream = definition.get_stream()

Related types

AdjustInterestToPaymentDate

Name Value Description
AdjustInterestToPaymentDate.ADJUSTED 'Adjusted'
AdjustInterestToPaymentDate.UNADJUSTED 'Unadjusted'

BusinessDayConvention

  • BbswModifiedFollowing (adjusts dates according to the BBSW Modified Following convention),
  • ModifiedFollowing (adjusts dates according to the Modified Following convention - next business day unless is it goes into the next month, preceeding is used in that case),
  • NextBusinessDay (adjusts dates according to the Following convention - Next Business Day),
  • NoMoving (does not adjust dates),
  • PreviousBusinessDay (adjusts dates according to the Preceeding convention - Previous Business Day).
Name Value Description
BusinessDayConvention.BBSW_MODIFIED_FOLLOWING 'BbswModifiedFollowing'
BusinessDayConvention.EVERY_THIRD_WEDNESDAY 'EveryThirdWednesday'
BusinessDayConvention.MODIFIED_FOLLOWING 'ModifiedFollowing'
BusinessDayConvention.NEXT_BUSINESS_DAY 'NextBusinessDay'
BusinessDayConvention.NO_MOVING 'NoMoving'
BusinessDayConvention.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY 'PreviousBusinessDay'

DateRollingConvention

  • Last (For setting the calculated date to the last working day),
  • Last28 (For setting the calculated date to the last working day. 28FEB being always considered as the last working day),
  • Same (For setting the calculated date to the same day . In this latter case, the date may be moved according to the date moving convention if it is a non-working day),
  • Same28 (For setting the calculated date to the same day .28FEB being always considered as the last working day).
Name Value Description
DateRollingConvention.LAST 'Last'
DateRollingConvention.LAST28 'Last28'
DateRollingConvention.SAME 'Same'
DateRollingConvention.SAME28 'Same28'

Direction

  • 'Paid' (the cash flows of the leg are paid to the counterparty),
  • 'Received' (the cash flows of the leg are received from the counterparty). Optional for a single leg instrument (like a bond), in that case default value is Received. It is mandatory for a multi-instrument leg instrument (like Swap or CDS leg).
Name Value Description
Direction.PAID 'Paid'
Direction.RECEIVED 'Received'

IndexAverageMethod

Name Value Description
IndexAverageMethod.ARITHMETIC_AVERAGE 'ArithmeticAverage'
IndexAverageMethod.COMPOUNDED_ACTUAL 'CompoundedActual'
IndexAverageMethod.COMPOUNDED_AVERAGE_RATE 'CompoundedAverageRate'
IndexAverageMethod.DAILY_COMPOUNDED_AVERAGE 'DailyCompoundedAverage'

IndexCompoundingMethod

  • Compounded (uses the compounded average rate from multiple fixings),
  • Average (uses the arithmetic average rate from multiple fixings),
  • Constant (uses the last published rate among multiple fixings),
  • AdjustedCompounded (uses Chinese 7-day repo fixing),
  • MexicanCompounded (uses Mexican Bremse fixing).
Name Value Description
IndexCompoundingMethod.ADJUSTED_COMPOUNDED 'AdjustedCompounded'
IndexCompoundingMethod.AVERAGE 'Average'
IndexCompoundingMethod.COMPOUNDED 'Compounded'
IndexCompoundingMethod.CONSTANT 'Constant'
IndexCompoundingMethod.MEXICAN_COMPOUNDED 'MexicanCompounded'

IndexObservationMethod

  • Lookback (uses the interest period for both rate accrual and interest payment),
  • PeriodShift (uses the observation period for both rate accrual and interest payment),
  • Mixed (uses the observation period for rate accrual and the interest period for interest payment).
Name Value Description
IndexObservationMethod.LOOKBACK 'Lookback'
IndexObservationMethod.MIXED 'Mixed'
IndexObservationMethod.PERIOD_SHIFT 'PeriodShift'

InterestType

  • 'Fixed' (the leg has a fixed coupon),
  • 'Float' (the leg has a floating rate index). Mandatory.
Name Value Description
InterestType.FIXED 'Fixed'
InterestType.FLOAT 'Float'
InterestType.STEPPED 'Stepped'

StubRule

  • ShortFirstProRata (to create a short period between the start date and the first coupon date, and pay a smaller amount of interest for the short period.All coupon dates are calculated backward from the maturity date),
  • ShortFirstFull (to create a short period between the start date and the first coupon date, and pay a regular coupon on the first coupon date. All coupon dates are calculated backward from the maturity date),
  • LongFirstFull (to create a long period between the start date and the second coupon date, and pay a regular coupon on the second coupon date. All coupon dates are calculated backward from the maturity date),
  • ShortLastProRata (to create a short period between the last payment date and maturity, and pay a smaller amount of interest for the short period. All coupon dates are calculated forward from the start date). This property may also be used in conjunction with first_regular_payment_date and last_regular_payment_date; in that case the following values can be defined:
  • Issue (all dates are aligned on the issue date),
  • Maturity (all dates are aligned on the maturity date).
Name Value Description
StubRule.ISSUE 'Issue'
StubRule.LONG_FIRST_FULL 'LongFirstFull'
StubRule.MATURITY 'Maturity'
StubRule.SHORT_FIRST_FULL 'ShortFirstFull'
StubRule.SHORT_FIRST_PRO_RATA 'ShortFirstProRata'
StubRule.SHORT_LAST_PRO_RATA 'ShortLastProRata'
